name: WireMark
kicker: See the work. Mark the work. Move the work.
summary: A visual-first environment for understanding a running product, connecting what you see to the source that made it, and directing agents with precise evidence.
thesis: Software work should begin with the product itself—not a scavenger hunt through files, tickets, and screenshots.
workflow: Trace it into source and context
Hand verified intent to people or agents
proof: Built as a working repository-to-canvas environment
Designed around privacy, provenance, and review
limitation: WireMark is in active development; interface details and integrations will continue to evolve.
